name: Isis: The Fall
source:
Amidst centuries-long space conflict between Alliance of Free Planets and Neo-Terran Confederacy, allied cruiser FSS "Isis" is sent on a mission that could turn the tides of war. However, among it's crew, there's one officer that wants to pursue his own devious plan...

Isis: The Fall is a visual novel in which you follow one man's quest for revenge. Seven powerful female crew members of "Isis" are ripe for conquest; can you bring them to fall and save your homeland from another defeat?

[From [url=https://tjord.itch.io/isis-the-fall]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自由行星联盟与新地球邦联之间的太空战争已持续数百年。联盟巡洋舰FSS“伊西斯号”受命执行一项可能扭转战局的任务。然而，船上有一名军官，却打算实施自己的阴谋…

《Isis: The Fall》是一部围绕一名男子的复仇之路展开的视觉小说。“伊西斯号”上七位位高权重的女性船员正等待着被征服。你能让她们沦陷，让祖国免于再次战败吗？

[摘自[url=https://tjord.itch.io/isis-the-fall]itch.io[/url]]
